_doc: The fallen and what a blow throws (specification 003 T008, Prender-262, Prender-265): a blow of force 5 on a street corner where people walk (60, 8; at the centre, force 3 reached nobody and force 20 buried the one body under the towers it felled), the clock running; four seconds after it, the body nearest the blow (setViewNear body: the effects' bodies, the dead included) near (60 px a metre) from 45 degrees at four azimuths: the body lying where it came to rest, its pool spread under it there, splashes where it struck, the pieces thrown in their tints (effects.json tints); then the corner from above, mid (15). By day.
